subject: Private MAP playbook: on-prem connectivity & owner alignment
messages:
From: Alex Tran <alex.tran@nebula-sec.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: private MAP + on-prem connectivity owners

Hi Ava —

Thanks for taking time to run the MAP with us. We’re excited to move the Private deployment evaluation forward. Per our call last week, Nebula’s timeline is aggressive: evaluation cluster up within three weeks, security review and procurement signed within six weeks.

To avoid surprises, we want to align on who owns what from both sides for networking (VPN / direct connect), IAM / KMS access, and the final topology sign-off. Quick ask: can Redwood confirm the internal owners and a single technical contact for each area so we can schedule targeted workshops?

I’ve attached our current VPC diagram and a short checklist for Nebula’s security team. We’ll follow the MAP playbook but want to make sure owners are assigned up front.

Proposed Nebula owners:
- Networking: Priya Das (pri...@nebula-sec.com)
- Security lead: Alex Tran
- Procurement: Nebula Security procurement team (cc’d on follow-ups)

Suggested next steps from Redwood side:
1) Intro thread with owners (by end of day Monday)
2) 60-minute connectivity workshop (networking + VPN / routing) — target Tue/Wed next week
3) IAM/KMS access matrix review — separate 45-minute slot

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth kickoff.

Best,
Alex
Director of Cloud Ops
Nebula Security

Attachments: nebula-current-vpc-drawing.png (image), nebula-security-checklist.pdf (doc)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Tran <alex.tran@nebula-sec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: private MAP + on-prem connectivity owners

Alex —

Appreciate the clear timeline. Quick intros and owner assignments from Redwood below so procurement and network teams have single points of contact:

Redwood owners:
- Connectivity / networking lead: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) — will run the VPN / peering workshop and validate routes.
- IAM / KMS & compliance: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.ai) — will own key access patterns, audit log expectations, and KMS integration plan.
- Deployment topology & SRE liaison: Mina Haddad (mina.haddad@redwood.ai) — will coordinate instance sizing, private registry access, and on-prem orchestration notes.

I’ll also attach our MAP playbook excerpt (redwood-onprem-map-playbook-v1.pdf) with checkpoints and expected artifacts per milestone.

Proposed dates:
- Connectivity workshop: Tue 2027-04-20 10:00-11:00 PT
- IAM/KMS review: Wed 2027-04-21 09:00-09:45 PT
- Evaluation cluster target: 2027-05-05 (we can iterate earlier if all pre-reqs clear)

Please confirm whether those slots work for Nebula and who from networking (Priya?) will join. Also flag any procurement constraints (e.g., PO terms, data locality requirements) so Marissa and Karthik can surface blockers in the workshops.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-onprem-map-playbook-v1.pdf

From: Priya Das <priya.das@nebula-sec.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Alex Tran <alex.tran@nebula-sec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: private MAP + on-prem connectivity owners

Thanks Ava — those owners look right. I’ll join the connectivity workshop and bring our network engineer (Tom Li from Nebula). A couple of notes from procurement/security upfront:

- Nebula requires HSM-backed KMS for key storage in production; for evaluation, KMS with audit logging is acceptable but must be on the roadmap.
- We prefer mutual TLS for the initial VPN setup; if Redwood supports IPsec + IKEv2 that’s fine too — Marissa, can you outline supported options in the workshop?
- Procurement will need an initial SOW and an estimated monthly reserved capacity number for Dedicated (not final, just for budget).

We can confirm Priya/Tom for the connectivity session on Tue 2027-04-20 10am PT. If you want to shift earlier, we can try 9am.

—Priya
Head of Cloud Platform
Nebula Security

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Das <priya.das@nebula-sec.com>, Alex Tran <alex.tran@nebula-sec.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: private MAP + on-prem connectivity owners

Thanks all — confirmed for Tue 2027-04-20 10:00 PT.

Agenda I’ll cover in the 60-minute connectivity workshop:
- 10m: Introductions & scope (peer vs direct connect vs VPN)
- 20m: Required network artifacts from Nebula (subnet plan, NAT/egress constraints, firewall rules)
- 15m: Redwood recommended topology for on-prem evaluation (VXLAN + peered load balancers)
- 15m: Action items & timeline (who delivers what by when)

Immediate asks for Nebula before the session:
1) Provide the subnet CIDRs and firewall ACLs for the evaluation racks (attach to the Drive link)
2) Confirm whether Tom will perform packet capture with us for the initial handshake tests
3) Any procurement constraints on temporary open ports for evaluation (we usually need 8443, 5060, and ephemeral ports for control-plane)

Karthik — I’ll leave the KMS specifics to you in the follow-up IAM session, but flagging that we can support both cloud-KMS integrations and HSM-backed on-prem solutions; we’ll outline tradeoffs.

I’ll also upload a short checklist to the shared Drive ahead of the meeting. See you all on the call.

—Marissa
Principal Deployment Engineer, Redwood Inference
